observation_field_dictionary.subject_code: Pseudonymous subject identifier; no personal identity
observation_field_dictionary.side: LEFT / RIGHT / UNKNOWN; never inferred from OBJ
observation_field_dictionary.state_id: Explicit operational condition; UNKNOWN permitted but blocks endpoint inference
observation_field_dictionary.timestamp_s: Seconds relative to a declared event, not a patient identifier
observation_field_dictionary.source: URL or authorized data identifier, SHA-256, version, license/permission and access level
observation_field_dictionary.physical_space: Native voxel spacing in mm, direction and acquisition metadata; registration transform and Jacobian audit
observation_field_dictionary.method: 3D_CT / 3D_MR / VALIDATED_3D_US / FORMULA_ESTIMATE / MASS_BALANCE; never interchangeable without validation
observation_field_dictionary.medical_domain: Boundary/cutoff labels, masks, terminal and ureter inclusion, device occupancy
observation_field_dictionary.D2_mapping: Verified correspondence, signed b_domain_mL, state dependence, uncertainty and source boundary mappings; UNKNOWN is not zero
observation_field_dictionary.capacity: Observed value, explicit mL/mm3/cm3 unit, fluid versus lumen definition; missing value null
observation_field_dictionary.conditions: Hydration/diuresis, bladder/voiding, posture/respiration, scan phase, outlet, devices and loading history; all unknowns explicit
observation_field_dictionary.uncertainty: Independent SD/bounds, common bias, scale uncertainty, correlations, segmentation reader and replicate identifiers
observation_field_dictionary.pressure: Local value, Pa/mmHg/cmH2O, measurement location, atmospheric zero, sampling and timing, not supply pressure
observation_field_dictionary.flows: Q_in, Q_out, Q_leak/absorption, Q_urine if not already included in Q_in; explicit mL/s and common clock
observation_field_dictionary.storage_occupancy: Initial absolute fluid mL; external storage derivative; device/gas/stone mL; measured or supported bounds, not silent zero
observation_field_dictionary.coverage: How this observation covers the predefined endpoint condition; not observed min/max by default
